name: unity-cli
description: Unity Editor automation via unity-cli — scene inspection, GameObject editing, prefab workflows, C# navigation/editing, asset management, input system, testing, and UI automation.

source.ref_name: stable@2026-09-30 (upstream v0.15.2 + #242 daemon fix + #357 loopback host + #360 daemon pipe leak)

methods.name: cargo
methods.command: MSVC_LINK=$(find '/c/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio' '/c/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft Visual Studio' -name 'link.exe' -path '*/Hostx64/x64/*' 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -n "$MSVC_LINK" ]; then export PATH="$(dirname "$MSVC_LINK"):$PATH" && cargo install --git https://github.com/arghhhhh/unity-cli.git --force --rev d1d7906e47e387f0b39f2855a6f59da3bf5c3948 && bash "$HOME/.claude/.skill-repos/claude-skills/skill-groups/unity-cli/install/sync-managed.sh"; else echo 'MSVC Build Tools not found — install via: winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override "--quiet --wait --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --includeRecommended"' && false; fi

install._check_note: Keyed to the pinned SHA, not 'unity-cli --version': the version string is identical across fork pins (and matches upstream releases), so a version check skipped every upgrade.

_user_env_note: UNITY_CLI_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 stops the managed binary (~/.unity/tools/unity-cli/<rid>/, what unityd runs) from auto-updating to an upstream release, which would silently drop the fork's unreleased fixes (#242, #357, #360). Do NOT add UNITY_CLI_HOST here: when it is set, resolve_endpoint ignores 'instances set-active' entirely. The fork build defaults to 127.0.0.1 instead.

integration_test.description: Unity Editor must be running with com.akiojin.unity-cli-bridge package installed
